# ReviewsBoost

> ReviewsBoost specialises in Google review removal assistance for Canadian businesses, alongside reputation support and practical public resources. It is independent and is not affiliated with Google.

## Service area

Services are exclusively for business locations in Canada. Online support covers all ten provinces and three territories, including smaller communities. Removal fees are in CAD. The [Canadian coverage section](https://reviewsboost.ca/online-reputation-management.html#canada) lists representative markets; it does not describe physical branch offices. Public resources remain readable worldwide.

## Primary pages

- [Google review removal](https://reviewsboost.ca/): Professional policy-based assessment, evidence preparation, reporting and eligible follow-up for Canadian businesses. CAD $45 upfront per accepted review plus $95 for each successfully removed review; removal is not guaranteed.
- [Suppression d’avis Google en français](https://reviewsboost.ca/suppression-avis-google.html): Service géré de suppression d’avis Google à Toronto, Montréal, Vancouver et partout au Canada, avec tarifs et formulaire en français.




- [Online reputation management](https://reviewsboost.ca/online-reputation-management.html): Google review concerns, monitoring, response planning and recovery for Canadian businesses.
- [Learning Centre](https://reviewsboost.ca/blog.html): Index of all educational resources.
- [About](https://reviewsboost.ca/about.html): Scope, principles, contact information and independence statement.
- [Editorial policy](https://reviewsboost.ca/editorial-policy.html): Sourcing, authorship, corrections and content standards.

## Guides and tools

- [Google review extortion and the zero-loss data gap](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-extortion-canada-data-study.html): Original aggregation of 22,801 broader Canada-coded CAFC extortion records, with three figures and 31 open aggregate rows. Not Google-specific counts, removal odds or a business-only sample.

- [Google review removal timing study](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-removal-time-study.html): Original observation-window sensitivity analysis of seven attributed deleted-review cohorts and six period averages, with two separate synthetic scenarios. Creation-to-deletion age is different from report processing time.


- [Google review removal cost in Canada](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-removal-cost-canada.html): Canadian pricing guide covering Google reporting, ReviewsBoost fees, sample totals, provider selection and tracked success-rate methodology.


- [Review removal checker and evidence builder](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-removal-checker.html): A private concern-specific evidence checklist with report-stage guidance and a downloadable case worksheet.

- [How to get more Google reviews](https://reviewsboost.ca/get-more-google-reviews.html): Authentic, incentive-free customer request process.
- [Google reviews not showing](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-reviews-not-showing.html): Delayed, missing and disappearing review troubleshooting.
- [Fake review statistics](https://reviewsboost.ca/fake-review-statistics.html): A seven-year Google moderation series, cross-platform disclosures, regulator cases, transparent calculations and downloadable CSV data with machine-readable metadata.
- [Google review rating resilience study](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-rating-resilience-study.html): An original 420-scenario mathematical analysis of how review count buffers exact averages against incoming one-star ratings.
- [How to respond to Google reviews](https://reviewsboost.ca/respond-to-google-reviews.html): Response framework and 30 examples.
- [How to report a fake Google review](https://reviewsboost.ca/remove-fake-google-review.html): Assessment, evidence, official reporting and follow-up.
- [Google review link and QR code](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-link-qr-code.html): Setup, testing, placement and accessibility.
- [Google review policy for Canadian businesses](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-policy-canada.html): Platform rules and Canadian context.
- [Google reviews FAQ](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-reviews-faq.html): Forty-one detailed questions and answers.
- [Review rating calculator](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-calculator.html): Weighted-average calculator with feasible integer-star ranges for rounded public ratings, exact targets and shareable scenarios.

## Open data and citation files

- [Google removal timing analysis](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-removal-time-analysis.json): Cohort inputs, conditional calendar bounds, weighted period reconstruction, assumptions and separate synthetic examples; not Canadian case outcomes.
- [Timing study citation](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-removal-time-study.cff): Versioned citation record for the original ReviewsBoost analysis.


- [Cross-platform review disclosure data](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-maps-review-moderation-2019-2025.csv): Source-labelled CSV with W3C CSVW metadata.
- [Google Maps moderation series, 2019-2025](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-maps-review-moderation-2019-2025.csv): Seven-year first-party disclosure series with W3C CSVW metadata.
- [Citation metadata](https://reviewsboost.ca/CITATION.cff): Citation File Format metadata for the original compilation.
- [Rating resilience dataset](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-rating-resilience.csv): The complete 420-scenario CSV with W3C CSVW metadata and reproducible JavaScript.
- [Rating resilience citation metadata](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-rating-resilience-study.cff): Citation File Format metadata for the original study.

## Important limitations

- Google controls its platforms, search results and moderation decisions.
- Educational content is general information, not legal advice or a guarantee of rankings, ratings or outcomes.
- Primary-source links and visible review dates should be used to verify time-sensitive policy claims.

- [Google fake business profile data audit](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-fake-business-profile-statistics.html): Original 21-row classification of 2019–2025 Google disclosures; profiles, creation attempts and ownership attempts are separate units.

- [Google review replies and removal: timing audit](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-replies-removal-bias-study.html): Six source cohorts, 18 conditional model cells, precision checks and three graphs.
- [Reply/removal analysis data](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-reply-removal-study.json): source attribution, assumptions and model labels.
